> > `1-154`: **Repo-wide texture hygiene — many textures found with isReadable:1 and fallback physics enabled** > > Scan of the repo confirmed numerous .png.meta entries with isReadable: 1 and many with spriteGenerateFallbackPhysicsShape: 1 (notable places: Assets/Sprites/Season Pass, Assets/Store/MonetizationOffers, multiple ThirdParty/VFX packs). These flags increase memory and build size — disable them where not required. > > - Re-run the audit (multiline mode to avoid the rg error): > rg -n -U --glob '**/*.png.meta' '^\s*isReadable:\s*1\b' -C2 > rg -n -U --glob '**/*.png.meta' '^\s*spriteGenerateFallbackPhysicsShape:\s*1\b' -C2 > > - Quick fixes (Linux): list matches then flip flags in .meta files: > rg -l -U --glob '**/*.png.meta' '^\s*isReadable:\s*1\b' | xargs -r -n1 sed -i 's/isReadable: 1/isReadable: 0/' > rg -l -U --glob '**/*.png.meta' '^\s*spriteGenerateFallbackPhysicsShape:\s*1\b' | xargs -r -n1 sed -i 's/spriteGenerateFallbackPhysicsShape: 1/spriteGenerateFallbackPhysicsShape: 0/' > > - Process: run the fixes in a dedicated PR that changes only .meta files, document exceptions (assets that need Read/Write or runtime physics), and reimport in Unity to verify visuals and build size. > >

> Assets/Scripts/UI/MainMenu/IconsOrderHandler.cs (4)
> > `89-101`: **Bug: displaced icon detection runs after the move, so it usually selects the arriving icon** > > You move the arriving icon first, then query “who was at targetIndex,” which now returns the same icon. That pushes the arriving icon to _firstAvailableIndex and never orders the displaced one. Callers will see wrong ordering nondeterministically. > > > Fix by identifying the displaced icon before moving, and re-order it without mutating the loaded set: > > ```diff > - if (targetIndex < _firstAvailableIndex) > - { > - // Move the arriving icon into its target slot > - icon.Transform.SetSiblingIndex(targetIndex); > - // If an icon currently occupies that slot, push it to the first available slot > - var wrongPlacedIcon = _icons.FirstOrDefault(i => i != null && i.Transform != null && i.Transform.GetSiblingIndex() == targetIndex); > - if (wrongPlacedIcon != null) > - { > - wrongPlacedIcon.Transform.SetSiblingIndex(_firstAvailableIndex); > - // Let existing logic bubble this through (no-op if already marked as loaded) > - OnLoadIconLoaded(wrongPlacedIcon); > - } > - } > + if (targetIndex < _firstAvailableIndex) > + { > + // Identify displaced icon BEFORE moving > + var displaced = _icons.FirstOrDefault(i => > + i != null && i != icon && i.Transform != null && > + i.Transform.GetSiblingIndex() == targetIndex); > + > + // Move arriving icon into its target slot > + icon.Transform.SetSiblingIndex(targetIndex); > + > + // If something was there, push it to the first available slot and re-order it > + if (displaced != null) > + { > + displaced.Transform.SetSiblingIndex(_firstAvailableIndex); > + OrderIcon(displaced); > + } > + } > ``` > > --- > > `49-52`: **StopCoroutine on _waitAllRoutine is dead; also null out _debounceRoutine after stopping** > > Since the startup wait isn’t started anymore, this StopCoroutine is a no‑op. Clean up and null the handle you do stop. > > > ```diff > - if (_waitAllRoutine != null) StopCoroutine(_waitAllRoutine); > - if (_debounceRoutine != null) StopCoroutine(_debounceRoutine); > + if (_debounceRoutine != null) > + { > + StopCoroutine(_debounceRoutine); > + _debounceRoutine = null; > + } > ``` > > --- > > `24-27`: **Remove unused _waitAllRoutine field** > Dead after removing the startup wait. > > > ```diff > private VerticalLayoutDynamicResizer _resizer; > - private Coroutine _waitAllRoutine; > private Coroutine _debounceRoutine; > ``` > > --- > > `109-121`: **Remove unused coroutine WaitForAllOrTimeout()** > Not referenced anymore; keeping it is confusing and retains a serialized knob (initialWaitSeconds) that no longer does anything. > > > ```diff > - private IEnumerator WaitForAllOrTimeout() > - { > - float t = 0f; > - // Wait until either all currently active icons reported loaded, or we hit a timeout. > - while (t < initialWaitSeconds && _loaded.Count < ActiveIcons().Count()) > - { > - t += Time.unscaledDeltaTime; > - yield return null; > - } > - > - FinalizeLayout(); > - } > ``` > >

> Assets/Scripts/Backend/ServerRequester.cs (3)
> > `198-203`: **Fix retry: passing full URL to RequestCR causes malformed URLs on retried requests.** > > `RequestCR` expects a route, not a full URL. On retry you pass `requestURL` which already includes `baseUrl`, leading to `baseUrl/baseUrl/route`. > > Apply this diff: > > ```diff > - Instance.StartCoroutine(RequestCR(requestURL, code, request, onSuccess, onError, blocksScreen, handling, baseUrl)); > + Instance.StartCoroutine(RequestCR(route, code, request, onSuccess, onError, blocksScreen, handling, baseUrl)); > ``` > > --- > > `299-303`: **Apply the same retry fix for POST.** > > Same bug as the GET branch. > > ```diff > - Instance.StartCoroutine(RequestCR(requestURL, code, request, onSuccess, onError, blocksScreen, handling, baseUrl)); > + Instance.StartCoroutine(RequestCR(route, code, request, onSuccess, onError, blocksScreen, handling, baseUrl)); > ``` > > --- > > `226-231`: **Do not log auth tokens.** > > Dumping the bearer token to logs is a security risk and a compliance foot‑gun. > > ```diff > - Debug.Log("[Backend] requestURL: " + requestURL + "Auth token: " + GameDataStore.Instance.LoginRequestData?.auth_token); > + Debug.Log($"[Backend] requestURL: {requestURL}"); > ``` > >

ERarityType.Common : ERarityType.Epic; > > - if (rewardScreenData == null) > + if (rewardScreenData == null) > { > if (CardPackOpenScreen.Instance != null) > { > CardPackOpenScreen.Instance.OpenPack(packRarity); > } > else > { > Debug.LogWarning("CardPackOpenScreen.Instance is null; cannot open pack."); > } > } > + else > + { > + var prior = rewardScreenData.CloseCallback; > + rewardScreenData.CloseCallback = () => > + { > + if (CardPackOpenScreen.Instance != null) > + CardPackOpenScreen.Instance.OpenPack(packRarity, closeCallback: prior); > + else > + prior?.Invoke(); > + }; > + } > } > ``` > >
